jp_election.name: Town of Monkton Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the Monkton block lists only five justices of the peace: Jane B. Low, Kathy Malzac, Jerry Schwarz, Kenneth Wheeling, and Valerie Mullin. The Town of Monkton's own Directory of Town Officials -- in both the 2025 Annual Town Report and the standalone directory updated August 24, 2026 -- lists TEN justices of the peace, each marked 'Elected (November Election)' for the two-year term February 2025 to January 2027: Kristen Blanchette, Lynne Caulfield, Jane Low, Kathy Malzac, Renee McGuiness, Amy Moody, Norma Norris, Jerry Schwarz, Gail Vansteamberg, and William Vansteamberg. The town's two concordant directories govern and the ten are recorded as the winners; Wheeling and Mullin appear in no town source and are not recorded as holders. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
Town of Monkton (official website), Directory of Town Officials (updated August 24, 2026): lists the ten justices of the peace named in the election note, each marked elected at the November election
Town of Monkton, 2025 Annual Town Report, Directory of Town Officials: the 2025 Annual Town Report's directory lists the same ten justices of the peace
